entities.name: Nicol Bolas
entities.description: The youngest and most infamous of the Elder Dragons and a planeswalker, later stripped of his names and imprisoned by Ugin.

entities.name: Ugin
entities.description: Bolas's twin brother, a planeswalker who became the Spirit Dragon and imprisoned Bolas in the Meditation Realm.

entities.name: Ur-Dragon
entities.description: The progenitor of the Elder Dragons, from whose wings the egg-stones fell.

entities.name: Merrevia Sal
entities.description: Bolas and Ugin's newly hatched sister, killed by humans and their dogs.

entities.name: Arcades Sabboth
entities.description: An Elder Dragon with whom the twins lived, defeated by Bolas's troops on Jamuraa.

entities.name: Chromium
entities.description: An Elder Dragon who pointed out the twins shared their names.

entities.name: Palladia-Mors
entities.description: An Elder Dragon who mocked the twins' size.

entities.name: Elder Dragon War
entities.description: The thousands-of-years conflict among the Elder Dragons that Bolas won.

entities.name: Meditation Realm
entities.description: Ugin's Prison Realm, where Bolas was imprisoned.

entities.name: Dominaria
entities.description: The plane where the Elder Dragons hatched and Bolas fought many battles.

entities.name: Madara
entities.description: The island chain of Dominaria where Bolas reigned as God-Emperor.

entities.name: Demonic Leviathan
entities.description: A planeswalker leviathan Bolas fought and devoured, causing the Shattering of Madara.

entities.name: Azor
entities.description: A planeswalker who devised the Immortal Sun plan with Ugin to imprison Bolas.

entities.name: Immortal Sun
entities.description: An artifact created from Azor's spark to trap Bolas, later used by Bolas to trap planeswalkers on Ravnica.

entities.name: Yasova Dragonclaw
entities.description: Khan of the Temur clan whom Bolas used as a pawn against Ugin.

entities.name: Naiva
entities.description: A twin granddaughter of Yasova.

entities.name: Tarkir
entities.description: The plane where Bolas defeated Ugin with Yasova's help.

entities.name: Sarkhan Vol
entities.description: A planeswalker who saved Ugin by traveling back in time and later served Bolas.

entities.name: Tetsuo Umezawa
entities.description: Bolas's Imperial Champion who turned against him and killed him on the Meditation Plane.

entities.name: Teferi
entities.description: A planeswalker whom Bolas fought on Madara and let live.

entities.name: Venser
entities.description: A planeswalker whose latent spark Bolas used to escape the rift.

entities.name: Leshrac
entities.description: A planeswalker defeated by Bolas and imprisoned in a mask.

entities.name: Amonkhet
entities.description: The plane Bolas corrupted and built into a breeding ground of Eternals.

entities.name: Bontu
entities.description: An Amonkhet god who conspired with Bolas and was killed by him.

entities.name: Hazoret
entities.description: An Amonkhet god Bontu was commanded to kill.

entities.name: Oketra
entities.description: An Amonkhet god obliterated by Bolas.

entities.name: Liliana Vess
entities.description: A necromancer planeswalker whose demonic contract defaulted to Bolas.

entities.name: Alara
entities.description: The plane where Bolas engineered the Conflux.

entities.name: Malfegor
entities.description: Bolas's second-in-command on Alara.

entities.name: Thraximundar
entities.description: A figure Bolas guided across the Alaran shards.

entities.name: Tezzeret
entities.description: An artificer who served Bolas, usurped his consortium, and was used by him.

entities.name: Ral Zarek
entities.description: A young Ravnican recruited by Bolas for clandestine jobs.

entities.name: Jace Beleren
entities.description: A mind mage who defeated Tezzeret and later conjured the illusion of Bolas's death.

entities.name: Ajani
entities.description: A leonin planeswalker who summoned the essence of Bolas's soul to fight him.

entities.name: Chandra Nalaar
entities.description: A pyromancer manipulated by Bolas into arriving at the Eye of Ugin.

entities.name: Gideon Jura
entities.description: A Gatewatch member who sacrificed himself to save Liliana.

entities.name: Nissa Revane
entities.description: A Gatewatch member forced to flee Bolas on Amonkhet.

entities.name: Gatewatch
entities.description: The group of planeswalkers that Bolas considered for his plans.

entities.name: Vraska
entities.description: A gorgon who retrieved the Immortal Sun for Bolas and led the Golgari under his influence.

entities.name: Ixalan
entities.description: The plane where Vraska found the Immortal Sun.

entities.name: Dovin Baan
entities.description: An Azorius figure under Bolas's influence entrusted with the Immortal Sun.

entities.name: Niv-Mizzet
entities.description: The Izzet dragon who fought Bolas on Ravnica and later impaled him.

entities.name: Ravnica
entities.description: The plane Bolas invaded in the War of the Spark.

entities.name: Eye of Ugin
entities.description: The Zendikar site Bolas studied and had Sarkhan guard.

entities.name: Zendikar
entities.description: The volatile plane where Bolas manipulated the Eldrazi's release.

entities.name: War of the Spark
entities.description: The war in which Bolas became a near-omnipotent Dragon-God before his downfall.

entities.name: Elderspell
entities.description: The spell Bolas cast to harvest sparks and gain godhood.

entities.name: Spirit-Gem
entities.description: The gem between Bolas's horns, made from a piece of Ugin's soul.

entities.name: Dreadhorde
entities.description: Bolas's army of Eternals led by Liliana.

entities.name: Narset
entities.description: A planeswalker who found the Meditation Realm with Jace and Elspeth.

entities.name: Elspeth Tirel
entities.description: A planeswalker who attacked Jace, unwittingly letting Bolas remember his name.

entities.name: Dack Fayden
entities.description: A planeswalker whose spark was harvested.

entities.name: Echoverse
entities.description: The alternate multiverse created by Jace that excluded Bolas.

events.summary: Nicol and Ugin hatch together and witness the murder of their sister Merrevia Sal.
events.quote: Nicol expressed outrage, but Ugin convinced him not to aid her

events.summary: Bolas starts the Dragon-killers' War by tricking dragon hunters into a feud and takes over as supreme leader.
events.quote: After starting the Dragon-killers' War by tricking the dragon hunters into a bloody feud between several factions, Bolas took over as supreme leader.

events.summary: Bolas's attempt to use Ugin shocks him into igniting his spark.
events.quote: This mental shock caused Ugin's planeswalker's spark to ignite

events.summary: Bolas wins the Elder Dragon War and his own spark ignites in envy of Ugin.
events.quote: in rage and envy of Ugin's newly-revealed planeswalker status, Bolas's own spark ignited

events.summary: Bolas kills Ugin on the Meditation Plane.
events.quote: they returned to the Meditation Realm, where Bolas killed Ugin

events.summary: Bolas fights and devours a Demonic Leviathan, causing the Shattering of Madara.
events.quote: In the end, the dragon relied upon his touch to defeat his foe.

events.summary: Bolas learns of Azor and Ugin's plan to imprison him.
events.quote: Bolas discovered the plan thanks to Azor leaving hints of himself on the planes that he had ordered.

events.summary: Bolas recruits Yasova Dragonclaw as a pawn on Tarkir.
events.quote: He found a willing pawn in Yasova Dragonclaw

events.summary: Bolas defeats Ugin on Tarkir with Yasova's help, leading to the Khanfall.
events.quote: Bolas was finally able to defeat the Spirit Dragon when he and Yasova turned Ugin's own lesser dragons against him.

events.summary: Sarkhan travels back in time and saves Ugin in a hedron cocoon.
events.quote: saved Ugin by encasing him in a hedron cocoon immediately after the battle ended

events.summary: Yasova tricks Bolas into fleeing Tarkir.
events.quote: Yasova saved Naiva from Bolas's influence and tricked the elder dragon into thinking that Ugin's grave was targeted by the Immortal Sun to trap him away.

events.summary: Bolas slays the Empress of Madara and reigns as God-Emperor for 150 years.
events.quote: eventually slew the then-Empress of Madara

events.summary: Tetsuo Umezawa destroys the Imperial Shrine with Bolas's body inside.
events.quote: Using the Meteor Hammer spell, Tetsuo destroyed the Imperial Shrine while Bolas's physical body was inside

events.summary: Tetsuo Umezawa defeats and kills Bolas on the Meditation Plane.
events.quote: Bolas was defeated and killed by Umezawa.

events.summary: Bolas escapes the rift and is reborn using Venser's latent spark.
events.quote: he was able to finally escape his prison and be fully reborn into the physical world

events.summary: Bolas defeats Teferi in a duel and tortures him with his touch.
events.quote: he tortured him with his mind-shattering touch and ripped his body to pieces

events.summary: Bolas defeats Leshrac and imprisons him in a mask.
events.quote: the latter was defeated after an epic battle and was imprisoned in the mask of the Myojin of Night's Reach

events.summary: Bolas arrives on Amonkhet and corrupts it, killing every adult being.
events.quote: he cast a spell that killed every single adult being on the plane

events.summary: Bolas brokers Liliana's contract with four demons.
events.quote: Bolas proceeded to act as a broker for four demons to form a contract with her

events.summary: Bolas takes Tezzeret into his service.
events.quote: Bolas offered him power in exchange for servitude, which Tezzeret accepted.

events.summary: Bolas recruits the young Ral Zarek on Ravnica.
events.quote: Disguised as a human, Bolas recruited the young Ral Zarek on Ravnica for several clandestine jobs.

events.summary: Tezzeret usurps Bolas's consortium; Jace later defeats Tezzeret as part of a plan Bolas agreed to.
events.quote: after he defeated Tezzeret in a duel and crushed the artificer's mind

events.summary: Ajani summons the essence of Bolas's soul to fight Bolas, and the two dragons vanish.
events.quote: he summoned the essence of Bolas's soul to fight for him

events.summary: Bolas manipulates Chandra and sends Sarkhan to the Eye of Ugin to release the Eldrazi.
events.quote: Bolas sent Sarkhan to the Eye and manipulated the pyromancer Chandra Nalaar into arriving at the same time.

events.summary: Bolas has Bontu killed by the undead after she defeats Hazoret.
events.quote: Bolas instead rewarded her with death, forcing numerous undead to tear her apart.

events.summary: Bolas defeats the Gatewatch on Amonkhet; Gideon, Chandra, Nissa and Liliana flee.
events.quote: Gideon fled too, leaving Bolas victorious.

events.summary: Vraska finds the Immortal Sun for Bolas and Tezzeret takes it away.
events.quote: After Vraska had found the artifact, she summoned Tezzeret, who took it away with his Planar Bridge.

events.summary: Niv-Mizzet fights Bolas on Ravnica and dies, leaving only his skull and charred bones.
events.quote: In the end, Niv-Mizzet's skull and charred bones were all that remained.

events.summary: Bolas traps the planeswalkers on Ravnica with the Immortal Sun.
events.quote: Bolas trapped them there through the use of the Immortal Sun

events.summary: Liliana turns the Dreadhorde on Bolas; he invokes her contract and Gideon sacrifices himself to save her.
events.quote: Gideon then sacrificed himself to save Liliana from the contract.

events.summary: Niv-Mizzet impaled Bolas with Hazoret's spear.
events.quote: Niv-Mizzet impaled Nicol Bolas through the back with Hazoret's spear

events.summary: Bontu bites Bolas and harvests all his sparks, leaving him desparked.
events.quote: the distraction allowed Bontu to bite Bolas and harvest all of the elder dragon's sparks, including Bolas's own

events.summary: Ugin has Jace create an illusion of Bolas's death and takes Bolas away.
events.quote: Jace reluctantly complied, fooling the other planeswalkers long enough for Ugin to planeswalk into Ravnica undetected and then planeswalk out with Bolas in tow.

events.summary: Ugin strips Bolas of both his names and imprisons him in the Meditation Realm.
events.quote: Ugin then informed Bolas that he had lost the use of both his names so that he couldn't be summoned by another being ever again.

events.summary: Ugin becomes Bolas's jailer for the rest of his mortal life.
events.quote: Ugin told his brother that he'd become his jailer for the remainder of Bolas's mortal life

events.summary: Elspeth's attack unwittingly lets Bolas remember his name.
events.quote: Elspeth assumed that he was in league with Bolas and attacked, unwittingly allowing the dragon to remember his name.

events.summary: The Meditation Realm collapses, erasing Jace, and Bolas escapes into the Multiverse.
events.quote: Taking advantage of the confusion, Bolas evaded his brother and escaped into the Multiverse.
